name: Gutter cannon
description: A heavy scattergun pulled off a wrecked hauler and welded to a new mount. It throws a wide pattern of slag.

name: Long harpoon
description: A rail mount taken from a mining tug and stretched until it reached further. Accuracy varies.

name: Hull harpoon
description: A big rail gun lifted from a freighter's tow gear. It is rough, but nobody enjoys being hit by it.

name: Scrapchucker flak
description: A flak mount loaded with whatever shrapnel the crew had to hand. It does the job against fighters.

name: Bodge torpedo
description: A torpedo rebuilt from a salvaged warhead and a freight tug's guidance. It goes where it is pointed, mostly.
